reproducibility: Built from `git archive` of the commit (not the working tree) in separate containers and via scripts/verify-contract-wasm.ps1: identical hash every time.
sandboxTests: 6 passed in a local near-sandbox against this exact release WASM (owner init, third-party takeover refused, duplicate init refused, uninitialized contract inert and recoverable, atomic deploy+init, rollback on failed init); mutation-checked: removing #[private] makes the takeover test fail
initPolicy: new() is #[private]: only the contract account itself (holder of its key) can initialize; #[init] rejects a second initialization
forbiddenHostCalls: none: no promise_*, transfer, deploy, add/delete key, stake or cross-contract calls
embeddedGuards: only the owner may record entries
audit_id already recorded with different content
content_hash must be 64 lowercase hex characters
decision must be PERMIT, DENY or ESCALATE
